notes: Play starts at disc 1. Dragging a song moves it into place instead of swapping two songs. Clicking outside the Edit song panel closes it. Song lists show the date of the version in use between status and time (projects and folders). Versions have notes. Songs have a Kind: Song, Instrumental, Audio file or SFX. Sidebar: hover a project or album cover for a play button; Shift+click an album tile just opens it. Hide the sidebar with the arrow by the logo or Ctrl+B. Click a project cover to see it large. Local digital albums can be edited. Import asks for the artist. Project menu: Go to CD Creator, and Export (the whole project with its CD files). Windows media overlay shows the song, artist, album and cover. CD viewer song list has playback controls. New CD visualizer button on project pages. Volume slider is finer and more even. Updates go back to the installer: Compass checks for a new version, downloads it and installs it. The check now sees new versions right away.

items: Play starts at disc 1. Dragging a song moves it into place instead of swapping two songs. Clicking outside the Edit song panel closes it.
Song lists show the date of the version in use between status and time (projects and folders). Versions have notes. Songs have a Kind: Song, Instrumental, Audio file or SFX.
Sidebar: hover a project or album cover for a play button; Shift+click an album tile just opens it. Hide the sidebar with the arrow by the logo or Ctrl+B.
Click a project cover to see it large. Local digital albums can be edited. Import asks for the artist. Project menu: Go to CD Creator, and Export (the whole project with its CD files).
Windows media overlay shows the song, artist, album and cover. CD viewer song list has playback controls. New CD visualizer button on project pages. Volume slider is finer and more even.
Updates go back to the installer: Compass checks for a new version, downloads it and installs it. The check now sees new versions right away.
Sidebar: Digital albums starts higher, under a shorter Projects list that scrolls.
Sidebar: nine most recently played digital albums, starting just above halfway.
Updates reload by themselves once they’ve downloaded, waiting until nothing is playing and no window is open.
Sidebar: Digital albums starts halfway down, Projects has the top half.
Sidebar: Projects shows up to six; below it, your six most recently played digital albums as cover tiles. Click either heading to open it in the Library.
CD case: the spine column is as thin as a real one, so art in the tray card’s spine window lines up and shows in full.
Account button in the top right on every page: your picture; click it for your stats (projects, albums, songs, plays, listening time, most played). Friends will live here later.
CD Creator 3D view: Open/Close case, Remove/Put back disc and Reset view buttons are back in the top bar.
CD viewer and Store pages: the case always starts closed and slowly turning.
Fix: the developer account can claim reserved usernames for itself.
Signing in opens a short setup: profile picture, @username, and listener / artist / producer / manager (pick any).
Settings › Profile: change your picture and roles.
Usernames: after signing in, claim your @username in Settings › Profile. Names are unique. Reserved names can only be awarded from the developer account.

Accounts: once you sign in, Compass saves a list of your library to your account (every project, digital album and song, and which albums are verified; not the audio). It updates a minute after you change something. Settings › Profile shows when it last saved.
Accounts: Settings › Profile › Sign in with Google. Your artist name syncs to your account and comes back on any computer. Your login is stored encrypted by Windows.
CD case: the hinge side is modelled like a real jewel case: a clear spine column with the inside tray card showing through it, hinge blocks at the corners, and a tray that stops at the column.
CD viewer: Background button with Dark, Light, Album colors, Blurred cover, any color, or your own image. The background reflects in the case’s plastic. Volume slider in the viewer.
Library search also finds projects and albums inside folders.
Settings: Recently deleted shows five items, with Show all.
Launcher: projects open in the FL Studio version that saved them (FL 20, 21, 2024, 2025…), or the version you picked by right-clicking the icon. Each project shows its version on its icon.
Songs: normal cursor on hover. Settings › Appearance › Song spacing (Compact is the default).
Themes mod: Settings › Mods › Themes › Get, then pick a theme under Appearance. Add your own in its mod.json.

Library: search and sort (Recent, Name, Artist, Year) for Projects, Digital albums and Archive, plus a Filter menu (All, Verified, Local) for digital albums. Cards: the verified seal sits right after the name, long names wrap to two lines, and digital albums show artist · songs · year.
CD Creator: removed the green “CD started” check on CD cards, so it isn’t mistaken for the verified seal.
Updates: most updates now install inside Compass in the background and load with Reload, no installer. Releases that change the Windows side still use the installer.

Fix: 1.15.0 could empty your library list the first time it started. If yours is empty, Compass offers to restore the copy from before the update (your audio and covers were never touched). Settings › Backup › Find an older copy does the same any time.

Verified albums: digital albums from the Store, the Marketplace, a QR card or your own Publish carry a green verified seal. Albums you add from files are Local. Everything already in your Digital albums is verified.
Digital albums: filter All, Verified or Local.
Music Store: sxteen ways – Movie is free. Get adds a verified copy to your library; the QR card gives the same album.

CD Creator: new CD100 template set (CD100 booklet, CDT100 tray card, UD100 disc). Guides follow the printer’s templates: bleed, trim, safety, spine folds, the spine window inside the tray card, and the disc’s print rings. Print files use ⅛ in bleed and a full 122 mm disc square.
New CDs use the CD100 set. Existing CDs stay on Classic; switch any CD under Template in the side panel.
Rolled back the 1.14.0 case look.
CD case look updated (rolled back in 1.14.1).
